subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm your flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on June 15th, 2022. Your itinerary is as follows: Flight ABC123, Departure: 10:00 AM, Arrival: 1:00 PM. Please make sure to arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before your flight. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels, The Airline Team
